subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR land before there is redacted live persona SecretRef TTS/Gateway proof and before optional TTS SecretRef startup behavior from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 is settled?
rationale: The implementation shape is right, but the patch expands which user-supplied credentials are actively resolved, and current runtime behavior can fail closed for unavailable active SecretRefs.

options.title: Require proof and settle startup boundary
options.body: Ask for redacted live output from a persona SecretRef TTS/Gateway run and either sequence this after the optional-TTS startup fix or explicitly accept the fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Merge on targeted tests now
options.body: Maintainers can accept the collector and registry tests as enough, while owning the risk that live credential resolution and startup behavior were not proven.

options.title: Pause for the startup PR
options.body: Hold this PR until the optional TTS SecretRef startup behavior is merged or rejected, then rebase and review the combined credential semantics.

recommendation.title: Require proof and settle startup boundary
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live output from a persona SecretRef TTS/Gateway run and either sequence this after the optional-TTS startup fix or explicitly accept the fail-closed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice centers on the SecretRef runtime framework and active credential-resolution boundary introduced in the broad SecretRef expansion.
